name: Tempester n°22: panel LED states sent over MIDI (CC 104 = on, CC 105 = off, CC 107 = full state request)
explanation: Dependency: requires n°9b (patch/nrpn_emission.json, its SENDCC routine at 0x9d07a504, which must be in the same build) and, through n°9b, n°9a (patch/nrpn_reception.json). The app could not show the LEDs: the Main never told anything about them. Every LED change goes through [routine](cmd, idx) (42 callers; PMP address 0 = idx, address 3 = cmd). In the Panel 1.3 firmware (command dispatcher [routine]) cmd 0x10 / 0x11 set / clear the lit bit of LED idx; 0x13, 0x22, 0x23, 0x24 only set a brightness level (1, 8, 4, 2), 0x14 a 25-tick flash, cmd 7 clears flags of another Panel table: only 0x10 / 0x11 are mirrored. [routine] also runs in interrupts (Timer 4: [routine] -> [routine] -> [routine]; Timer 3 and UART5: real-time MIDI and Song Position -> [routine]), where the MIDI output must not run (DIN send ring without overflow check, USB send busy-waiting on [address]). So: (1) [routine]'s first panel write goes through a hook (0x9d07c400) that, for cmd 0x10/0x11 and idx < 0x3C, writes lit (0/1) into the external SRAM word 0x3DA00 + idx ([routine], under di; one write, no read-modify-write) and sets the byte flag [address]; the first such command since boot zeroes the 128 shadow words (lit 0x3DA00-0x3DA3F, sent 0x3DA40-0x3DA7F) under di. 0x3DA00-0x3DBFF is reached by no code (n°16, patch/sram_ring.json). (2) [routine] (main loop only) tail-calls [routine] through DRAIN ([address] -> 0x9d07c4d4): when changes are pending, Remote Pad OUT is not Off and the DIN send ring holds at most 16 bytes, it sends up to 4 differences per pass (lit != sent) as CC 104 (on) / CC 105 (off), value = LED index, on channel Remote Pad OUT - 1, through SENDCC of nrpn_emission (0x9d07a504: DIN then USB), and records them as sent. (3) [routine] ([address] -> 0x9d07c618): CC 107 on the Remote Pad IN channel ([address], 0 = All) requests the full state: every sent word is set to 2, so every LED is sent again; bit 0 of the CC 107 value enables the 16 pad LEDs (0x2C-0x3B), off at boot. The event 10 of CC 107 is still published (ignored, as before). RAM: [address] (pad LEDs), [address] (shadow initialised), [address] (request), [address] (pending): bytes of the old DIN NRPN parser state, whose accessors ([address]-[address]) are unreachable, not used by nrpn_reception ([address]-20D, [address]-215, [address] only). Requires nrpn_emission (SENDCC).

edits.why: jal 0x9d07c400 ; [routine]: was "jal [address]" ([routine](idx, 0)), done first by the hook. Delay slot "clear a1" kept; s0 = cmd & 0xff, a0 = idx & 0xff
j 0x9d07c4d4 ; [routine] (main loop only): was "j [address]" (tail call to [routine]), now made by DRAIN; delay slot "addiu sp,sp,0x18" kept
j 0x9d07c618 ; [routine]: was "lui t1,0xa002" (redone at REQUEST, with the delay slot below)
addiu sp,sp,-0x20 ; any context (main loop or IPL 4 interrupt). Live: a0 = idx, a1 = 0, s0 = cmd, ra = [address]
or s1,a0,zero ; delay slot: s1 = idx
lbu t1,-0x7f7a(gp) ; delay slot: [address] shadow initialised?
jal [address] ; [routine](addr, lit): single write under di, no read-modify-write
sb t1,-0x7f77(gp) ; [address] = 1: changes pending (byte store, atomic)
addiu sp,sp,-0x20 ; first LED command since boot: zero the 128 shadow words under di
lbu t1,-0x7f7a(gp) ; re-checked with interrupts off
addiu sp,sp,-0x30 ; main loop only. Live: ra = main, sp = main's ([routine] frame already popped)
lbu t1,-0x7f7a(gp) ; delay slot: shadow initialised?
beq t1,zero,0x9d07c5f8 ; no LED command yet: the request waits
jal [address] ; sent[i] = 2 (differs from 0 and 1): every LED is sent again
lbu t1,0x49ec(gp) ; delay slot: Remote Pad OUT [address] (0 = Off)
beq t1,zero,0x9d07c5f8 ; Off: nothing sent, the flag stays
DIN send ring write index [address] | read index [address]
beq t2,zero,0x9d07c5f8 ; more than 16 bytes waiting: later
sb zero,-0x7f77(gp) ; cleared before the scan: a change during it raises it again
li s3,0x4 ; at most 4 messages per pass
lbu t0,-0x7f82(gp) ; delay slot: [address] pad LEDs enabled?
beq t0,zero,0x9d07c5d8 ; pad LEDs 0x2C-0x3B only when enabled
beq s3,zero,0x9d07c5f0 ; budget spent: next pass
jal 0x9d07a504 ; SENDCC(channel, CC, LED index) of nrpn_emission: DIN B0|ch CC v, then USB
sb t1,-0x7f77(gp) ; more to send next pass
replaced instruction; the delay slot "addiu v0,t1,-0x2724" already ran with a stale t1: redone below
lbu t3,0x49eb(gp) ; delay slot: Remote Pad IN [address] (0 = All), the rule of CC 12/13
sb t2,-0x7f82(gp) ; [address] = bit 0 of the value: pad LEDs included
sb t2,-0x7f79(gp) ; [address] = 1: full state requested (sent by the main loop)
j [address] ; rest of [routine] (event 10 published as before)
